_about: Isopropyl acetate (1) + Methyl acetate (2): isobaric bubble temperatures at 101.3 kPa (no vapour compositions are fitted). Rows: liquid mole fraction of isopropyl acetate, boiling temperature in K, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: L. Xiao, Q. L. Wang, H. X. Wang, T. Qiu, Isobaric vapor-liquid equilibrium data for the binary system methyl acetate + isopropyl acetate and the quaternary system methyl acetate + methanol + isopropanol + isopropyl acetate at 101.3 kPa, Fluid Phase Equilib. 344 (2013) 79-83
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 16, 17. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. Fitted to the bubble temperatures alone (Barker's method): no set of this pair with vapour compositions passes the consistency point test, or none was measured. Pure-component boiling points of the set within 0.76 K of the vapour-pressure records. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
